async def act(page):
    # Fill in the title for the new issue about dark mode implementation
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)")
    await title_textbox.fill("Implement Dark Mode")
    
    # Fill in the description for the new issue
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")
    await description_textbox.fill("Discuss the implementation of dark mode for the solarized-prism-theme project. This includes design considerations, technical requirements, and potential impact on users.")
    
    # Click the 'Issue' button to submit the new issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Issue")
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to load after submission to ensure the issue is created
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
